question.:question/worked-solution:
Here, we have the product of the two functions $u(x)=x^{2}$ and $v(x)=\sin{\left(x \right)}.$ So, we apply the product rule:

$$
\begin{aligned}(u(x)v(x))' &=u'(x)\cdot v(x)+u(x)\cdot v'(x) \\ &=(x^{2})'\cdot (\sin{\left(x \right)}) \\ &\quad +(x^{2})\cdot (\sin{\left(x \right)})' \\ &=(2 x)(\sin{\left(x \right)}) \\ &\quad +(x^{2})(\cos{\left(x \right)}) \\ &=2 x \sin{\left(x \right)} \\ &\quad +(x^{2} \cos{\left(x \right)})\end{aligned}
$$

generation.domain: real x where the factors are differentiable

\begin{aligned}(u(x)v(x))' &=u'(x)\cdot v(x)+u(x)\cdot v'(x) \\ &=(3 - \tan{\left(x \right)})'\cdot (\cos{\left(x \right)}) \\ &\quad +(3 - \tan{\left(x \right)})\cdot (\cos{\left(x \right)})' \\ &=(- \sec^{2}{\left(x \right)})(\cos{\left(x \right)}) \\ &\quad +(3 - \tan{\left(x \right)})(- \sin{\left(x \right)}) \\ &=- \cos{\left(x \right)} \sec^{2}{\left(x \right)} \\ &\quad +(- \left(3 - \tan{\left(x \right)}\right) \sin{\left(x \right)})\end{aligned}
$$
